programme.title: Monaco vs Barcelona - UEFA Champions League 2024/25 MD1
programme.desc: The only two meetings between Monaco and Barcelona previously came in the 1993-94 UEFA Champions League group stage, with Barca winning both games. This will be Barcelona’s 25th UEFA Champions League match against French teams – both teams have scored in 17 of the previous 24, with those matches averaging 3.6 goals per game. They faced PSG last season and those two games produced 10 goals.

programme.title: Feyenoord vs Bayer Leverkusen - UEFA Champions League 2024/25 MD1
programme.desc: Feyenoord and Bayer Leverkusen’s only previous meeting was in the last 16 of the 1987-88 UEFA Cup – the German side prevailed 3-2 on aggregate on their way to winning the trophy that season. Bayer Leverkusen have never lost a major European game against a Dutch side in six previous meetings, though this is their first since a 0-0 draw with PSV in the UEFA Cup in September 1994.

Arsenal vs PSG - UEFA Champions League 2024/25 MD2
programme.desc: Arsenal are unbeaten in their previous four meetings with Paris SG in European competition. Indeed, the French side have played more games against the Gunners without winning than against any other opponent in European competition. Paris SG have lost each of their last three away games against English sides in the UEFA Champions League, losing twice to Manchester City. and once to Newcastle last season. Their 1-4 defeat at St. James’ Park last term was their heaviest away defeat to an English opponent in European competition.

programme.title: Liverpool vs Bologna - UEFA Champions League 2024/25 MD2
programme.desc: Liverpool and Bologna have never previously faced before, while Bologna will be the Reds’ 10th different Italian opponent in European competition, after Internazionale, Juventus, Roma, Genoa, Milan, Fiorentina, Napoli, Udinese, and Atalanta. Bologna have faced three English sides previously in all European competitions, most recently Fulham in the 2002 Intertoto Cup. Their last in a major European competition came against Leeds United in the 1966-67 Inter-Cities Fairs Cup, losing via a coin toss after a 1-1 aggregate draw over two legs.

Brentford vs Manchester United - English Premier League 2024/25 Week 35
programme.desc: Brentford have won just one of their last 12 meetings with Manchester United in all competitions, a 4-0 home win in August 2022. 10 of Manchester United’s 12 Premier League goals against Brentford have come in the second half of games, with three of the last five coming after the 90th minute.

programme.title: Chelsea vs Liverpool - English Premier League 2024/25 Week 35
programme.desc: Chelsea are winless in their last 10 meetings with Liverpool in all competitions, only once before going longer without a win over the Reds. After their 2-1 win in October, Liverpool are looking to complete their first league double over Chelsea since their title-winning 2019-20 campaign. Arne Slot could become only the third Reds boss to win both of his first two league games against Chelsea in charge of the club, after Bill Shankly and Roy Evans.

programme.title: EPL Stories 2024/25 - Cesc Fàbregas
programme.desc: A product of Barcelona’s famed La Masia youth academy, Cesc Fabregas is rightly remembered as one of the greatest midfield players of his generation. After making his Arsenal debut at just 16 years of age the diminutive Spaniard would go on to win titles in both England and Spain as well as becoming a World Cup winner in 2010. Now taking his first steps into coaching with Como 1907, Fabregas reflects on his footballing education as well as his hopes for the future in management.

programme.title: Manchester City vs Wolverhampton Wanderers - English Premier League 2024/25 Week 35
programme.desc: Man City have won eight of their last nine Premier League home games against Wolves, with the exception being a 2-0 loss in October 2019. Since completing the double over Man City in 2019-20, Wolves have since lost eight of their last nine Premier League games against them.

programme.title: Brest, One Dream Sesaon In Champions League

programme.title: LaLiga-LALIGA’S BEST GOALKEEPER 2024/2025

We will also look back at his best saves and interventions.

programme.title: Real Valladolid vs Villarreal - LaLiga 2024/2025 Week 11

In fact, they have scored on each of their last three visits to Pucela, after failing to do so on nine of their previous 10 league trips.

programme.title: Espanyol vs Sevilla - LaLiga 2024/2025 Week 11
programme.desc: Espanyol have not won any of their last 10 games against Sevilla in LaLiga, and have never gone 11 in a row without beating the Nervión side in the competition. After two straight away defeats in 2016 and 2017, Sevilla have taken points in each of their last five LaLiga away games against Espanyol, equalling their longest unbeaten away run against Los Periquitos in the top-flight.

programme.title: Real Betis vs Atlético Madrid - LaLiga 2024/2025 Week 11
programme.desc: Real Betis have won just one of their last 15 home games against Atlético de Madrid in LaLiga, 1-0 in February 2019 under Quique Setién, drawing the last one. They have not avoided defeat in two successive home league games against Los Rojiblancos since January 2006. In the Simeone era, Atlético de Madrid have only lost 4.3% of their matches against Real Betis Balompié in LaLiga, only having a lower defeat percentage against Getafe in the competition among teams they’ve faced 15+ times.

programme.title: Real Sociedad vs Osasuna - LaLiga 2024/2025 Week 11

They have not lost back-to-back matches against Osasuna in the competition since September 2010. Following their victory at the Reale Arena in February 2024, Osasuna have the chance to win on two successive visits to Real Sociedad for the first time in the history of LaLiga.

programme.title: Girona vs Leganés - LaLiga 2024/2025 Week 12

programme.title: Atlético Madrid vs Las Palmas - LaLiga 2024/2025 Week 12

programme.title: Qualifying - Germany Round - Moto 3 - 2025
programme.desc: Moto3 qualifying at Sachsenring is a thriller. Light bikes, teen drivers, and slipstream games make for chaos and courage. In 2024, David Alonso stunned the field with a last-minute flyer from deep in the field. Track position is critical — Sachsenring’s short lap punishes traffic, and a clear run is gold. Watch for tactics in the final minutes as the riders queue for the perfect tow.

programme.title: Qualifying - Germany Round - Moto 2 - 2025
programme.desc: Intermediate class riders push their Triumph 765cc-powered machines to the edge at Sachsenring, seeking a clean lap and pole glory. In 2024, Jake Dixon edged out Arón Canet by just 0.034 seconds. Track temperature and traffic make every attempt critical. A strong qualifying position often correlates to race success — and Moto2 margins are the slimmest in racing.

programme.title: Main Race Qualifying - F1 Qatar Airways British Grand Prix - 2025
programme.desc: The battle for pole position heats up at Silverstone as drivers push to the limit in qualifying. With changing track conditions and high-speed corners, securing a front-row start is critical for success in Sunday’s race at this historic British circuit.

programme.title: Main Race - F1 Qatar Airways British Grand Prix - 2025
programme.desc: The lights go out at Silverstone for the main event of the weekend. Drivers take on the high-speed straights and legendary corners of one of Formula 1’s most historic tracks, with crucial points and national pride at stake in this iconic British Grand Prix.

programme.title: Cerro Largo (URU) vs Central Córdoba (ARG) - Copa Sudamericana 2025 - Round of 16 Playoffs - 2ND Leg
programme.desc: Live and exclusive coverage from South America of the Copa Sudamericana. The competition began in 2002, replacing the separate competitions Copa Merconorte and Copa Mercosur. programme.title: Manchester United vs Liverpool English Premier League 2024/2025
programme.desc: Manchester United have won just one of their last 12 Premier League meetings with Liverpool, beating them 2-1 at Old Trafford in their third game of the 2022-23 campaign. Liverpool have lost just one of their last six Premier League away games against Manchester United, while only Manchester City have won away at Old Trafford more often than the Reds in the competition’s history.

programme.title: Everton vs Liverpool - English Premier League 2024/2025
programme.desc: Everton won 2-0 in their last Premier League game against Liverpool in April 2024, last winning consecutive league Merseyside derbies in the 1984-85 campaign. Liverpool’s 2-0 loss in this exact fixture last season ended a 12-game unbeaten away run in the Premier League against Everton. They’ve not lost consecutive visits to Goodison Park since a run of three between 1992 and 1994.

programme.title: Manchester City vs Crystal Palace- English Premier League 2024/2025
programme.desc: Man City have lost just one of their last 12 Premier League games against Crystal Palace, going down 2-0 at home in October 2021. Having lost each of their first six Premier League visits to the Etihad Stadium, Crystal Palace have lost just two of their last six away to Man City in the competition.

programme.title: Denmark / France
programme.desc: This quarter -final of the Euro Espoirs promises to be explosive: Denmark, revelation of the tournament, challenges an ambitious French team. The Danes dominated a group noted with victories on Ukraine (3-2) and the Netherlands (2-1), before a draw without stake against Finland (2-2). Osula (3 goals, 2 assists) and Harder (2 goals) bear an effective attack, already the author of 7 goals in 3 games. Opposite, the blueberries have experienced ups and downs: hung by Portugal (0-0), saved in extremis against Georgia (3-2), they finished strong against Poland (4-1). Djaoui Cissé (double), Mathys Tel, Castello Lukeba and Guillaume Rests symbolize a team in power. Gérald Batic finally seems to have found a balance between offensive power and collective control. On paper, France is a favorite. But faced with a Danish selection in full confidence, this duel may well be the most spectacular of these quarters.

programme.title: Tennis : Wimbledon
programme.desc: A month after their epic final in Roland-Garros, Jannik Sinner and Carlos Alcaraz are doing this: the two masters of the ATP circuit meet in the Wimbledon final to write a new page of their rivalry. Winner in Paris after a crazy comeback, Alcaraz aims for a historic hat -trick in London (2023, 2024, 2025). Faced with him, Sinner dreams of a first coronation on lawn, which would allow him to conquer a third different major, at only 23 years old. It will be their 13th duel. The Spaniard leads 8-4, remains on five consecutive victories and has not been beaten by the Italian since October 2023. But their only confrontation on grass, already in Wimbledon, had turned to the advantage of Sinner in 2022. Alcaraz aims for continuity, sinner. Between two wonders already in legend, the final promises a summit up to their meteoric ascent.

Beaten by the Mannschaft in the group phase (2-1), the Young Lions of Lee Carsley have since raised the cursor. But Germany impresses even more. Intouchables in hens (9 points), Antonio Di Salvo's men first snatched their place in half against Italy (3-2 A.P.), before offset France (3-0). Between a revengeful England and a Germany in full control, this final promises intensity, talent and fireworks.

programme.title: Bath / Lyon
programme.desc: Two years after their triumph in Marseille, the Lyonnais find a CUP challenge final with the ambition to enrich their European list. Faced with them, a heavyweight of English rugby: Bath, the current leader of Premières, which aims a resounding double CUP Challenge - Premiership. The Lou advances with serious arguments. Davit Niniashvili, a X factor capable of blowing up any defense, a Bendeu hinge-Couilloud perfectly oiled, a Camille Cat back as heel holder, without forgetting a second Guillard line-William Impressive in the semi-finals against Racing 92. Despite a sawtooth season, the Rhodanians seem ready to strike a big blow to Cardiff. But Bath arrives launched. With the duo Charlie Ewels - Quinn Roux in spearhead of the pack, the Vista of Captain Ben Spencer at the melee and the magic of Finn Russell at the opening, the English intend to conclude their formidable season with a continental title. Duel of styles in sight, with a Euro trophy ...

programme.title: Tours / Poitiers
programme.desc: Last act, last breath: the TVB is about to live an evening with a history on Saturday in Grenon, against Poitiers. Winner at the first leg (3-1), Tours has a golden opportunity to win a 10th title of champion of France, which would propel him at the height of AS Cannes at the top of the hexagonal volleyball. But a derby does not obey any logic. Poitiers, heckled but far from being killed, knows that it would be a victory, four daring sets, to write his own legend. The feat of Nantes last year, who came to impose themselves in the gold set, feeds their hopes. The Alterna will count on Nik Mujanovic, in search of a last shine under the pepper colors before joining the TVB this summer. At the end of the road: Europe and the Champions League. But for Tours, it is also the culmination of a forged season in the fight. From Luca Ramon to Ryan Sclater, all want to write the perfect epilogue under the leadership of Marcelo Fronckowiak and engrave their name in the marble of Grenon.

Winners of the Leinster's courage in the semi-finals (37-34), the English bet on the vista of the young English prodigy, Henry Pollock, the end Smith's end at the opening and return of George Furbank to the rear to win a second European title. programme.title: Tennis : Wimbledon
programme.desc: A month after their epic final in Roland-Garros, Jannik Sinner and Carlos Alcaraz are doing this: the two masters of the ATP circuit meet in the Wimbledon final to write a new page of their rivalry. Winner in Paris after a crazy comeback, Alcaraz aims for a historic hat -trick in London (2023, 2024, 2025). Faced with him, Sinner dreams of a first coronation on lawn, which would allow him to conquer a third different major, at only 23 years old. It will be their 13th duel. The Spaniard leads 8-4, remains on five consecutive victories and has not been beaten by the Italian since October 2023. But their only confrontation on grass, already in Wimbledon, had turned to the advantage of Sinner in 2022. Alcaraz aims for continuity, sinner. Between two wonders already in legend, the final promises a summit up to their meteoric ascent.

programme.title: Finale Dames. Amanda Anisimova / Iga Swiatek
programme.desc: Make way for the grand finale of Wimbledon between the American Amanda Anisimova and the Polish Iga Swiatek. Surprising Sabalenka in the semi-finals (6-4, 4-6, 6-4), Anisimova, 23, competes his very first Grand Chelem final. Mentally solid, she had to fight against Galfi and Noskova, but knew how to seize her luck in a clear painting. It remains to be seen whether the American explosive will still have the energy to challenge the infernal regularity of Iga Swiatek. The world number 8 has left crumbs to its opponents, notably shipping Bencic in a half (6-2, 6-0). Already a quintuple winner in Grand Slam, the Polish is targeting a first coronation at Wimbledon to complete the loop. In full confidence and strong of his experience, Swiatek advances as a great favorite. Anisimova has dropped the world n ° 1, but it is the n ° 1 of the lawn moment that she finds today.

programme.title: Tours / Poitiers
programme.desc: Last act, last breath: the TVB is about to live an evening with a history on Saturday in Grenon, against Poitiers. Winner at the first leg (3-1), Tours has a golden opportunity to win a 10th title of champion of France, which would propel him at the height of AS Cannes at the top of the hexagonal volleyball. But a derby does not obey any logic. Poitiers, heckled but far from being killed, knows that it would be a victory, four daring sets, to write his own legend. The feat of Nantes last year, who came to impose themselves in the gold set, feeds their hopes. The Alterna will count on Nik Mujanovic, in search of a last shine under the pepper colors before joining the TVB this summer. At the end of the road: Europe and the Champions League. But for Tours, it is also the culmination of a forged season in the fight. From Luca Ramon to Ryan Sclater, all want to write the perfect epilogue under the leadership of Marcelo Fronckowiak and engrave their name in the marble of Grenon.
